configFields.label: Desk Type
configFields.help: Select the variant of the desk that is connected. Placed for potential future use.

configFields.label: Fader Update Rate (20 updates/sec)
configFields.help: Update rate of the faders in milliseconds. A lower values makes the transitions smoother but increases system load.

configFields.label: Status Poll Rate (0.33 updates/sec)
configFields.help: Some values need to be actively requested from the desk, this number sets the interval in milliseconds at which those requests occur.

configFields.label: Variable Update Rate (10 updates/sec)
configFields.help: Defines how many milliseconds elapse between variable updates. A lower number makes variables more responsive but may decrease system performance.

configFields.label: Fetch variables on startup
configFields.help: Request values for all variables when establishing a connection to a desk.

configFields.label: Show advanced options
configFields.help: Show advanced configuration options. There is no guarantee that these options will work in any combination.

configFields.label: Request Timeout (ms)
configFields.help: Time in milliseconds to wait for a response to a sent command before considering it lost.

configFields.label: Panic on lost request
configFields.help: If enabled, the module will log an error when a sent command does not receive a response within the specified timeframe.

configFields.label: Variable Request Chunk
configFields.help: When are requested in chunks on startup, waiting between each chunk

configFields.label: Variable Request Wait Time (ms)
configFields.help: When are requested in chunks on startup, waiting between each chunk

configFields.label: Subscription Interval (ms)
configFields.help: Time in milliseconds to wait between subscription requests.

configFields.label: Enable OSC Forwarding
configFields.help: Forward all received OSC messages to another OSC endpoint

configFields.label: Enable Debug Mode
configFields.help: Enable detailed logging including timestamps and source location information
